title: message_received data
description: Emitted when a message is received from a peer.

timestamp.description: RFC3339Nano timestamp: when the message arrived, by the local clock, as get_history_messages gives the time a message was stored. Order and merge messages by it.

sent_at.description: RFC3339Nano timestamp: the time the sender put on the message, by the sender's clock, which the sender can set to anything. Show it only as the sender's claim, as get_history_messages gives sent_at.
